messages:
nina: Quick note — our quickstart streaming sample leaks goroutines when creds rotate mid-stream with the SlimGen API.

omar: short repro?

nina: start gen with req ctx, spawn goroutine calling Next() to stream tokens. when refresh runs, Next() returns an empty part then hangs forever. handler exits, goroutine stuck.

lucy: does UpdateCreds swap transports? that can close sockets and leave readers in limbo.

nina: yes, UpdateCreds replaces the auth and may recreate transport. logs show repeated 'read 0 bytes' then silence, no error.

omar: proposed fix: add Gen.Interrupt() that unblocks Next() immediately, keep Close() as graceful. also make UpdateCreds mark in-flight streams stale so Next() returns ErrAuthRotated.

lucy: agree. add a tiny example in quickstart showing the pattern: create child ctx, defer gen.Interrupt(), loop Next().

ci-bot: opened issue #5033: "go-sdk: slimgen interrupt + auth-rotation" and linked thread.

nina: thanks — that should remove the main onboarding friction for the sample.
